correctness.rationale: Conditional Itô/Euler variance propagation gives f_d(h)=1-dh+h². With z=h1 h2 in [0,T²/4], the exact objective equals f_d(T)+(d²-dT-2)z+z². Strict convexity proves global optimal projection and uniqueness. Boundary thresholds follow from z0=0 and z0=T²/4. The inequality 0<Tc<T- for sqrt(2)<d<2 is proved by (d²-2)²>0; the large-T asymptotic uses roots of x²-Tx+z0. Exact rational checker passed 10,060 assertions. Infinite parameter claim is algebraic, not experimental.

value.rationale: The exact terminal covariance is a natural quantity in mesh-dependent SDE uncertainty propagation, yet optimizing it need not improve true solution accuracy. This is a complete classification in the smallest nontrivial adaptive-mesh family; the 4-regime reentrant uniform-mesh window, sharp sqrt(2) noise threshold, and open-simplex nonattainment identify a precise failure mode of unregularized surrogate optimization. It is a motivated, checkable benchmark rather than a general practical mesh recommendation.
